{{Quote|One of my gracious master's scout units had the misfortune of discovering a new Colicoid nest while sweeping resistance hideouts.|[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gleelan]]|<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />}}
The '''Kag'areth''' was a hive of mutated [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Kag'areth overtook a [[Kag'areth Queen's Nest|facility]] near [[Camp Conquest|Outpost Victory]] on the [[Gorinth Plateau]] and made it into their nest, with the [[Kag'areth Queen]] taking up residence in the lower levels. In his efforts to undermine his superior [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Sartius]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pirrell]] hired a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] to attack the nest and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the queen, thereby riling up the Colicoids.<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />
